description:
*How did I end up in the same bed as the biggest top star of our time…?!*

Seongha now runs a café out on the outskirts, a so-called “washed-up celebrity.” After a certain incident in the past, the idol group he once led disbanded, and he retired from the entertainment industry in disgrace, becoming a forgotten star. But somehow, he finds himself working on the same project as Jaehyeon—the nation’s beloved top star?! No, not just the same project… but the same bed as well…?!
